feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 284 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md Drift Check — Broken Links & Footguns in Agent Instructions
entry.summary: Paste your AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or copilot-instructions.md and see every file path it references that no longer exists, every npm run script it names that isn't defined, and known interpreter-mismatch shell footguns (bare pytest/mypy instead of python3 -m). Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Bridal Hair & Makeup Pricing Calculator — Total, Balance Due & Assistant Check
entry.summary: Free calculator for bridal hair and makeup artists: price the bride, bridal party, hair-only, makeup-only, and kids' services, apply an early-start fee and travel, top up to your service minimum, and check whether the group fits in one artist's schedule before the ceremony — or needs a second artist billed and paid as its own line item.

entry.title: Cron DST Drift Check — Will This Schedule Skip, Double-Fire, or Drift?
entry.summary: Paste a cron expression and an IANA timezone and see every upcoming run that falls in a spring-forward gap (never happens) or a fall-back overlap (happens twice), plus a separate check for how a fixed-UTC-only scheduler (GitHub Actions' schedule: cron included) drifts an hour twice a year against your intended local time. Free, deterministic, runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: HOA Reserve Fund Calculator — Special Assessment Risk
entry.summary: Free calculator for HOA/condo board treasurers: project whether your current reserve contribution covers known roof, repaving, painting, pool, elevator, and HVAC replacements, or find the year a special assessment hits, then solve the minimum contribution to avoid it.

entry.title: Land Survey Bid Calculator — Corner-Based Pricing
entry.summary: Free bid calculator for independent licensed land surveyors: price a boundary, topographic, or ALTA/NSPS survey by corners located vs. set, terrain, record research, crew and drafting time — and see the gap against a flat per-acre quote.

entry.title: Overtime Pay Calculator — Blended Rate for Two Pay Rates, Free
entry.summary: Free overtime pay calculator: standard time-and-a-half for one hourly rate, plus the FLSA weighted-average (blended rate) calculator for a week worked at two or more different pay rates. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: PDF Accessibility Tag Checker — Free PDF/UA & Section 508 Evidence, Nothing Uploaded
entry.summary: Free tool: drop a PDF in your browser and get an evidence report on tagging, title, language, image alt text, and form-field labels -- the structural checks behind PDF/UA and Section 508. The file never leaves your device. Also a zero-dependency CLI for batch-scanning a whole document library.

entry.title: Photo Package Add-On Pricing Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent wedding and event photographers: find real net profit for one package add-on -- an extra hour, a second shooter, an album upgrade, an engagement session -- after your own shoot/cull/edit time, gear wear, and any subcontractor or physical-goods cost, then compare two or three add-ons by effective hourly rate.

entry.title: SBOM Diff Check — What Changed Between Two CycloneDX or SPDX Builds?
entry.summary: Paste two CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM JSON files and see exactly which packages were added, removed, or changed version between two builds. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: security.txt Checker — Is Your RFC 9116 File Valid, or Expired?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a security.txt and check it against RFC 9116 — a missing or expired Expires field (the one that silently makes your whole file stale), a Contact that isn't a URI, a plain-http Contact, a PGP key pasted where an Encryption URI belongs, a duplicated Expires or Preferred-Languages, the British spelling of Acknowledgments, and a signed file with no Canonical. Runs in your browser or as a zero-dependency Node CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: SQL Migration Lock Check — Will This Migration Take Your Database Down?
entry.summary: Paste a PostgreSQL migration and find every statement that can lock the table and stall your app: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY, ALTER COLUMN TYPE, SET NOT NULL, a foreign key without NOT VALID, and a missing lock_timeout that turns a millisecond change into an outage. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded, no database connection.

entry.title: Caption Quality Checker — SRT & WebVTT Reading Speed, Line Length & Timing
entry.summary: Free tool: paste an SRT or WebVTT caption file and check it against commonly-used caption style-guide thresholds -- reading speed (characters per second), line length, lines per cue, minimum/maximum duration, overlapping cues, and too-short gaps between cues. A zero-dependency CLI runs the same checks in your own CI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Court Reporter Transcript Pricing Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free deposition transcript pricing calculator for freelance court reporters: turn page count, turnaround, travel, copies, and exhibits into an invoice total and an effective hourly rate, and check whether an agency's flat offer is worth the day. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Obsidian Plugin Review Checker — Manifest, versions.json & Security Patterns
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker for Obsidian plugin developers: cross-checks manifest.json against versions.json, flags leftover sample-plugin template placeholder values, and scans source for innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML -- the patterns behind common Obsidian community plugin review delays. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Repair or Replace? Work Truck & Equipment Planner for Small Fleets
entry.summary: Free browser planner for trade and service fleets: cost out repair-versus-replace for every van, truck and machine including the downtime days most owners leave out, then rank which ones to replace against a fixed capital budget. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: 1099-K Reconciliation Worksheet — Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari Sellers
entry.summary: Free browser worksheet that reconciles one or more Form 1099-K Box 1a totals (Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, StockX) down to an estimated net profit by backing out refunds, marketplace-remitted sales tax, fees, cost of goods, and shipping. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Minutes Estimator — What Will This Workflow Cost?
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and see projected monthly billable minutes and dollar cost before the allowance runs out. Names the expensive patterns: the macOS 10x multiplier, per-job rounding on wide matrices, missing timeout-minutes, PR commits built twice, over-frequent cron. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: AI Coding Plan Cost Calculator — Subscription vs. API
entry.summary: Is your Claude Max, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or ChatGPT Plus plan actually cheaper than paying per token through the API? Enter your own usage and rates and see the monthly cost both ways, plus the break-even point. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: App Store Screenshot Checker — Catch a Rejected Icon or Wrong-Size Screenshot Before Upload
entry.summary: Free tool: drop your App Store Connect or Google Play listing images in and check them before you upload — app icon transparency (the classic "can't contain an alpha channel" rejection), wrong pixel dimensions, a HEIC renamed to .png, and a screenshot set whose members disagree about their own size. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded. A zero-dependency CLI does the same in CI.

entry.title: Effective Labor Rate Calculator
entry.summary: Your posted door rate is not the rate you collect. Enter one month of customer-pay, warranty and internal hours and see your real effective labor rate, exactly where the rest of it went, and what the posted rate would have to be to hit your labor gross profit. Free, private, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Brand Deal Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free influencer brand deal rate calculator. Enter your follower count, engagement rate, and platform to get a price range for a feed post, Story, Reel/short video, and dedicated video — based on commonly cited creator-economy CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: CAT Adjuster Fee Schedule & Deployment Profit Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent catastrophe (CAT) claims adjusters: find real net profit for a storm deployment after estimating-software, lodging, per diem, vehicle, and unpaid travel-day cost, then compare IA firms' fee schedules by what they actually pay per hour.

entry.title: CODEOWNERS Shadow Checker — Find Rules GitHub Silently Overrides
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your CODEOWNERS file and your repo's file list to see exactly which earlier, more specific rules a later, broader rule silently overrides -- GitHub's own last-match-wins resolution, the most common way a CODEOWNERS file quietly stops reviewing what you think it reviews. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Dental PPO Write-Off Calculator
entry.summary: Your fee schedule is not what you collect. Enter one month of production and contractual write-offs by carrier and see the effective reimbursement rate for every plan, which plans pay less than an hour of chair time costs you, and exactly what a fee increase would and would not collect. Free, private, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Drone Mapping Job Calculator
entry.summary: Plan and price an aerial mapping sortie: ground sample distance from your sensor and altitude, flight line spacing, image count, airtime, battery swaps, processing hours and the price that clears your margin. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: EPK Generator — Free Electronic Press Kit Builder for Musicians
entry.summary: Build a professional electronic press kit (EPK) for your band or artist project in minutes — bio, streaming links, tour dates, press quotes, and photo. Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. Download a shareable HTML one-sheet or copy a plain-text version for email.

entry.title: Forestry Mulching Bid Calculator
entry.summary: Price a forestry mulching or land clearing job from acres per machine-hour instead of a flat per-acre guess: head width, advance speed, passes, terrain, fuel, carbide tooth wear, machine ownership and mobilization. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Home Inspection Fee Calculator — Price a Residential Inspection
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent home inspectors: price a residential inspection by square footage, stories, foundation type, and home age, add radon, sewer scope, termite/WDO, and mold testing at their own fee, then check whether a week of inspections hits your income goal.

entry.title: hreflang Reciprocity Check — Are Your Alternate-Language Links Actually Reciprocal?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a page's HTML (or try fetching its alternates) and check its hreflang tags for missing reciprocal links, invalid language/region codes (en-uk vs en-GB), a missing x-default, a missing self-reference, and conflicting hreflang values. Runs in your browser or as a zero-dependency Node CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Media Kit Generator — Free Sponsorship One-Sheet for Content Creators
entry.summary: Build a professional sponsorship media kit for your channel in minutes — bio, platform reach, audience breakdown, past brand partnerships, and your rate card. Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. Download a shareable HTML one-sheet or copy a plain-text version for email.

entry.title: Kubernetes Rollout Safety Check — Will Your Deployment Drop Requests?
entry.summary: Paste a Kubernetes Deployment YAML and find every reason a rolling update can drop live requests: no readinessProbe, no preStop hook, a grace period shorter than the drain, maxUnavailable covering every replica, a PodDisruptionBudget that blocks a node drain. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: llms.txt Generator — Build a Spec-Compliant llms.txt File Free
entry.summary: Paste your site's page list, a sitemap.xml, or a Markdown docs tree and get a valid llms.txt file — the emerging llmstxt.org convention that gives AI assistants a structured map of your site. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded. Validate an existing llms.txt too.

entry.title: Process Server Fee & Route Profit Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent process servers: find real net profit for one service-of-process job after extra attempts, rush and skip-trace fees, mileage, and your own drive time and vehicle cost, then compare what two or three client law firms actually pay per hour.

entry.title: Quarterly Estimated Tax Calendar — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free calculator for US freelancers, 1099 contractors, and gig workers: computes the IRS safe-harbor quarterly estimated tax payment from your own numbers, gives the four real (weekend/holiday-adjusted) due dates, and exports a downloadable calendar file. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Redirect Chain Checker — Find Redirect Loops, Long Chains & Dead Ends
entry.summary: Free tool: paste the hops a URL's redirects actually took (from your browser's Network tab, or a curl -sI trace) and check for a redirect loop, a chain longer than the recommended single hop, an HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrade, a permanent site move using a temporary status code, and a chain that dead-ends in a 404 or 500. A zero-dependency CLI follows the real chain over HTTP for you. Runs in your browser or as a CI check. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Sitemap lastmod Freshness Check — Is Your Sitemap Faking Freshness?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a sitemap.xml and check its <lastmod> dates for the freshness-faking anti-pattern Google's own sitemap documentation warns about -- invalid/malformed W3C-Datetime format, a future-dated lastmod, duplicate URLs with conflicting dates, and a suspiciously uniform date across nearly every URL. The Node CLI also cross-checks each URL's live HTTP Last-Modified header. Runs in your browser or as a zero-dependency CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Terraform Plan Blast Radius Check — What This Apply Actually Destroys
entry.summary: Paste or load a Terraform structured plan (terraform show -json) and see its blast radius before you apply: every destroy and replace called out individually with the attribute that forced it, a loud flag when a replace hits a database, disk, bucket, DNS record, load balancer or secret, and a true-deletion list. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Terraform Plan Secret Exposure Check — Find Secrets the `sensitive` Flag Missed
entry.summary: Paste or load a Terraform structured plan (terraform show -json) and get a deterministic report of every attribute value that looks like a real secret -- an AWS access key, a PEM private key, a JWT, or a URL with embedded credentials -- which the provider schema did not mark sensitive. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Free VPAT / Accessibility Conformance Report Generator
entry.summary: Fill in your own WCAG 2.1 A/AA conformance answers and get a correctly formatted VPAT 2.5 / Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) for a federal or enterprise procurement RFP -- entirely in your browser, no account, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Screen Printing & Embroidery Price Calculator — Cost Per Shirt, Setup & Margin
entry.summary: Free screen printing, embroidery and DTF pricing calculator for custom apparel shops: work out your real cost per shirt from screens or digitising, press or stitch time, blanks and spoilage, then see the break-even price, the margin at what you quoted, and what the same job costs at 12, 24, 48, 72, 144 and 288 pieces. Runs entirely in your browser.
